freshness.expectedContentHash: Lowercase hex of the article's generated tanah_article.content_hash (covers name/abstract/content/perek_id/author_id). Compared under the article row lock; a mismatch rejects the write as stale.
freshness.expectedCoveringSources: The exact {perekId,pasuk} set the caller read (order-insensitive). Compared under the same lock so a replaced covering set cannot overwrite an unseen edit.
freshness.expectedMoedIds: The exact moed id set the caller read in articleRelationships.moadim (order-insensitive). The generated contentHash covers the article row alone, so the junction set gets its own snapshot — a mismatch rejects the write the same way.

relationships.label: פרק ראשי
relationships.meaning: The article's single required canonical perek — placement, listing and default (unverified) coverage all derive from it.
relationships.writeContract: updateArticleRelationships.perekId — target must be an existing canonical perek; cannot be cleared (NOT NULL).
relationships.invalidates: article entity change with old ∪ new perekIds

relationships.label: מחבר
relationships.meaning: The article's single required author — drives author pages, listings and the byline.
relationships.writeContract: updateArticleRelationships.authorId — target must be an existing tanah_author row; cannot be cleared (NOT NULL).
relationships.invalidates: article entity change with old ∪ new authorIds

relationships.label: כיסוי פסוקים מאומת
relationships.meaning: Verified pasuk-level coverage: each row links the article to one canonical {perekId,pasuk} it covers. Meaningful only together with the coverageVerified flag — an unverified or absent set means coverage is unknown, never 'covers nothing'.
relationships.writeContract: updateArticleRelationships.coveringSources + .coverageVerified — integer coordinates, pasuk >= 1, within the canonical perek pasuk_count, no duplicates; verified requires at least one row; omitted leaves the set untouched, an explicit empty list clears it and marks coverage unknown.
relationships.invalidates: article entity change with coveringSpans for the destroyed side (the website unions the live rows)

relationships.label: הקדשות
relationships.meaning: Article-scoped dedication assignments honoring a subject, each carrying an optional assignment-level expiry distinct from the whole-dedication expiry.
relationships.writeContract: createDedication / updateDedication / deleteDedication with a DedicationTargetInput{kind: ARTICLE, articleId, expiresAt} target — the dedication aggregate owns its full target set; a replacement omits unlisted links. Article id must exist; expiresAt is UTC ISO-8601.
relationships.readContract: Public: dedications(context: {articleIds}) — active only. Admin: articleRelationships.dedications, dedicationsAdmin — all including expired.
relationships.invalidates: dedication entity change with old ∪ new articleIds

relationships.label: אנוטציות תנכפדיה
relationships.meaning: Stored span/intended-name annotations the mention pipeline computed over the article body (keyed by article id + content hash). An editorial annotation record, NOT an explicit FK-based article-to-entry link: resolution to a live entry happens by name at display time.
relationships.writeContract: Pipeline-owned: rows are produced by the data/annotations pipeline and upserted by devops/import-tanahpedia-mentions.mts. No admin/API write path — a parallel CRUD surface would compete with the pipeline's dedupe/content-hash lifecycle.
relationships.readContract: Admin: articleRelationships.mentionAnnotations (all acceptance states). Public website: resolved decorations only for auto/manual acceptance and matching content hash.
relationships.invalidates: pipeline import expires tanahpedia-mention-refs; article content edits invalidate decorations via content-hash mismatch

relationships.label: תאריך עברי חוזר
relationships.meaning: Assignment of an article to a recurring Hebrew month/day (annual daily-perek override, #3098). Each month/day has at most one chosen article.
relationships.writeContract: Pending — the #3098 schema has not landed on master. Integrate through this contract when the table exists; never fabricate month/day targets.

relationships.label: מועדים
relationships.meaning: Optional article-to-moed associations (#3101): a moed may carry zero/one/many articles, and an article may link to several moadim. Explicit links are the editorially approved set — unapproved #3103 proposals never land here.
relationships.writeContract: updateArticleRelationships.moedIds — every id must reference an existing tanah_moed row and be unique; omitted leaves the set untouched, an explicit empty list clears it. The moed catalogue itself is managed by upsertMoed/deleteMoed under the same key.
relationships.readContract: Public: Moed.articles (deduplicated union of explicit links and range-overlap matches), moadim/moed(slug). Admin: articleRelationships.moadim.
relationships.invalidates: article entity change plus one moed entity change per old ∪ new linked moed slug

internalDerivedTables.name: tanah_article_metric / tanah_article_metric_block
internalDerivedTables.reason: Computed reading metrics derived from article content — regenerated by the metrics pipeline, not user-editable content relationships.

internalDerivedTables.name: article_search_queue / article_search_*
internalDerivedTables.reason: Internal derived search-index sync state — the write paths enqueue into it as a side effect, not as a content link.

internalDerivedTables.name: daily bulletin / web-push tables
internalDerivedTables.reason: Delivery and scheduling jobs that reference articles — transport, not content relationships.
